messages.subject: Project Relay - Letter of Intent
messages.plaintextBody:
Rachel,

Following the NDA, please find Bracken's letter of intent for the proposed acquisition of Helix. It is subject to contract save for the binding provisions (exclusivity, costs, confidentiality and announcements at paras 8-11).

Headline: enterprise value of GBP 38,000,000 on a cash-free, debt-free basis; locked-box consideration mechanism to be agreed; approximately 10 per cent. of consideration into escrow post-completion; W&I insurance to be explored; 60-day exclusivity from countersignature. We would be grateful if Marcus and Lucy could countersign so we can open diligence in earnest.

Best,
Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.snippet: Elena, Our clients are content with the LOI in principle and will countersign. Two points for the re
messages.subject: RE: Project Relay - Letter of Intent
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Our clients are content with the LOI in principle and will countersign. Two points for the record, both for the SPA rather than the LOI: (1) the sellers expect a locked-box structure with a sensible set of permitted-leakage carve-outs (adviser costs, transaction bonuses and the like), and (2) if Bracken is taking out W&I, the sellers will want their warranty exposure to sit largely behind that policy. We will pick these up properly on the SPA.

Kind regards,
Rachel

Rachel Hargrove | Partner | Hargrove & Associates LLP
